title: Home practical guide: make a model river in a tray (sand or soil, a jug of water, small stones; with an adult, outside or over a sink)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y3 lesson 84 (Home practical guide: make a model river in a tray (sand or soil, a jug of water, small stones; with an adult, outside or over a sink))
intro: Lesson 84: A labelled diagram of a river from source to mouth. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see how a river flows from its source to its mouth
equipment: A tray (a baking tray or a plastic box lid)
A book to prop up one end
safety: Sand or soil, a jug of water, small stones
With an adult, outside or over a sink
Do this outside or over a sink
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Work outside or over a sink with an adult
Fill the tray with damp sand or soil and smooth it
Prop up one end with the book: this is the hills
Put a few stones near the top for hard rock
Pour water slowly from the jug at the high end (the source)
Watch where the water goes: does it bend (meander) or split? Where does it end (the mouth)?

questions.q: Name the end of a river
